theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners is the highest-ranked eligible theme not showing a crowding flag, with healthy breadth (0.75) and a durability bar (0.62) above the leader's (0.44). This is the challenger in the rotation structure with a wide margin to rank-3. The trend-gate leg is satisfied (eligible=true) and breadth suggests participation beyond one or two names, which I read as a more durable trend than rank alone shows.
theses.dissent: Silver miners are second-derivative plays on silver price which itself is heavily driven by real rates and the dollar — a macro factor this detector has no edge on. The high breadth could mark late-cycle participation (everyone has piled in already) rather than early trend.

falsifier.text: SIL loses more than 8% from 2026-09-11 while S&P 500 is flat or up over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners sits rank-3 with the strongest breadth reading in the top decile (0.917) and a high durability bar (0.73). Eligible under the absolute-trend gate and not crowded (crowding_z=0.24). This looks like a coherent, broadly participating trend rather than a narrow crowded one — the kind of structure I would prefer over the rank-1 leader which shows breadth=0.0.
theses.dissent: A breadth reading near 1.0 can mean every constituent is up — which may be a fully-matured advance with limited incremental buyers left. Gold miners are also crowded into a 'debasement/geopolitics' macro narrative that can unwind violently if real yields spike.

theses.thesis: Memory/HBM is the clear rank-1 leader and the dominant narrative, but it is simultaneously crowding-flagged (crowded=true, crowding_z=1.39) with breadth=0.0 — meaning the entire advance is concentrated in very few names and positioning is stretched. The guardrail explicitly says do NOT fade the leader, but I am also not required to overweight it. The trend-gate is satisfied (eligible) but the narrow breadth + crowding combination argues for standing aside rather than chasing.
theses.dissent: The momentum score (3.0) is enormous compared to rank-2 (1.56) — this is genuine leadership, and refusing it risks missing further gains if the HBM/AI-memory cycle continues. Crowding is only a size-down caution, not a sell, per guardrails.
